target_system: SteamOS desktop and Steam Big Picture / Gaming Mode
supported_game: Metal Gear Solid USA v1.0, both discs
known_limits: Continuous completion and full boss fights are not certified.
Native launcher, host pause/save menu and controller routing require physical controller and Vulkan acceptance on SteamOS.
Build on a supported Linux baseline before publishing; local development ABI is not a portable minimum requirement.
Vulkan visual and performance acceptance on physical hardware remains required.
